title: Zombie Apocalypse Part 1 - The Ration
notes: Interior, metres. Room spans x -4..4, z -2.55..3.55, ceiling 3.05. No motionFloor/holdDrift overrides: onecam derives them from scene scale and then per beat from each beat subject distance. An explicit 0.07 here left the far beats motionless for up to 2s. 2026-11-13: beats 2,3,4 re-staged - see each beat's content. The 'camera stays on an arc at z >= 1.25' rule no longer holds: beats 3 and 4 come inside it deliberately, and the spline was checked against the furniture. KEEP IN SYNC with films/zombie-p1/index.html (ROADMAP D4).

beats.name: window
beats.content: READ 1 - something is wrong outside. Boarded window, cold light in slats. A shape crosses it, once, unclear.

beats.name: find-them
beats.content: READ 2 - two people are in here. The camera pulls back and finds them: the human first, then Claude. Both still, both listening.
beats.narration: We stopped counting the ones outside.

beats.name: shelf
beats.content: READ 3 - there is almost no food. Re-staged 2026-11-13: the shelf was two planks on the far wall 3.65 m from the only light, which made this the darkest frame in the film (97.9% of pixels under 10% luma) and the weakest shot in it. Now a free-standing unit beside the table at 1.8 m, cans ~160 px and countable, wall behind it far enough that the hold drift parallaxes.

beats.name: hands
beats.content: READ 4 - they are dividing it. Re-framed 2026-11-13: the old framing covered only x -0.33..0.63, so BOTH figures were outside it and the can slid across an empty table by itself. Now favours the receiving side - the human's torso and arm hold frame left, the can arrives from Claude's side off-frame. Plays silent, deliberately.

beats.name: the-look
beats.content: READ 5 - Claude notices, and says nothing. THIS IS THE FILM. Re-aimed 2026-11-13: Claude's head yawed -0.5 rad on top of his -1.45 base facing, so the old camera saw the back of his head for most of the beat - the committed render has the same defect. Camera now sits on the axis his face points down, offset 31 deg for a 3/4.
beats.narration: He gave me the bigger pile.

beats.name: the-turn
beats.content: READ 6 - it is not over. A sound outside; both heads turn. The film ends on the turn, not after it.
